name: 710 Labs Live Rosin 2nd Press | Smorgi #30
description:
710 Labs Persy Rosin is the ultimate solvent-less extract that fuels the senses with excellent and definable terpene profiles and a clean and quick systemic high. The consistency is almost crystal clear and is incredible easy to maneuver. One can tell the difference when residuals are as close to non-existent as in the 710 Persy Line.
*Photo is of 710 Labs' Persy Live Rosin, but exact appearance will vary by strain and by batch*
